from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687674/attempts/fe7b32dd748346a8b1b7c0aebff056b5/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
prog='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    for row in out:\n        # A partial horizontal band ends where the row changes color; mark\n        # everything after that band with color 1.\n        changes = [i for i in range(1, len(row)) if row[i] != row[i - 1]]\n        if len(changes) == 1:\n            cut = changes[0]\n            row[cut:] = [1] * (len(row) - cut)\n    return out\n'''
path=program_dir/'task-c43af26b.py'

exec(compile(prog,str(path),'exec'),globals())
transform_fn=globals()['transform']
